author: visegrad24
text:
The CIA warned European governments of a possible Russian drone attack on Spain, France, or Italy

American intelligence gathered information that Russia is preparing such an attack on one of those Mediterranean countries and shared it with several European governments.

Drones could be launched from the sea, hidden in containers on a ship. A source close to Lithuania’s Defense Ministry said the type is a Gerbera: up to 18 kg, with a declared range up to 600 km. One merchant vessel can carry several.

Lithuania and other countries received the information shortly after CIA Director John Ratcliffe’s trip to Moscow on August 25. Ratcliffe arrived on a US military plane that stopped in Riga.

📰 El Mundo
